svg.title: Slip Study
svg.desc: Interpretive study after an actually inspected primary reference. Geometry and interpretive screen colour approximate. Small black-and-white study at left of the explicitly captioned installation photograph. Broad black upper field and white lower field with a rounded lower-left transition; frame excluded. Paper or canvas medium remains unverified. Foundation photograph explicitly labels this title and EK identifier; medium classification remains as sourced. Palette refinement (2026-11-09): source review remains unresolved for black, white; prior provisional screen colors retained, not calibrated to original paint.
svg.metadata: Primary reference: https://ellsworthkelly.org/exhibition/ellsworth-kelly-curated-by-jack-shear/; catalogue record foundation-exhib-v4-ek180-ellsworth-kelly-curated-by-jack-shear; inspected2026-10-27. Pure editable vector study, not photographic facsimile.
